note: TORRAS onboarding research (CJ advertiser 7951347, program cj:torras, approved 2026-11-24), facts from TORRAS's US stores via Shopify JSON, curl and WebFetch (r.jina.ai), plus the named reviews; sources per record. Cart tests in growth/focus/offers/data/torras-2026-11-25-carttests.jsonl. STORE HOST: TORRAS's US store is torraslife.com (Shopify, Irvine CA, USD); torras.com is an unrelated Spanish fashion house (Shopify, EUR) and must not be used. CJ links land on torraslife.com (evergreen link 17340644). Cooling products are only on the separate Shopify store coolify.torraslife.com (TORRAS-COOLiFY, USD, own cart); whether CJ tracking fires on that sub-store was not verified (no CJ tag visible in either store's static HTML, which is expected if CJ runs as a Shopify web pixel). Other TORRAS sub-stores exist (power.torraslife.com, glass.torraslife.com) and were not used. CJ KEYWORD RULE (TORRAS CJ program terms, read 2026-11-25): 'official', 'torras' and 'torraslife' are prohibited in any part of Dealectric's URLs, and 'coolify' in our domain, so no slug contains torras/torraslife/official; slugs use product-line names (ostand-..., minimag-..., coolify-...). The brand field still says TORRAS. NEW CATEGORY proposed for coolify-air: "personal-cooling": ('Personal coolers', 'Neck air conditioners, neck fans and handheld fans that cool one person at work, outdoors or on a commute.'). portable-ac (tent/van air conditioners) does not fit. PRICING: torraslife.com runs an automatic 'Black Friday 10% all' discount in the cart (1 item 10%, 2 items 15%, 3+ items 20%, no code, 2026-11-19 to 12-02); prices here are the 1-unit cart total after it. Codes replace it rather than stack. COOLiFY store had no automatic discount. CODES: WELCOMEBACK (CJ) works on all four picks, 15% off: Q3 Air $56.10, Q3 Air Pro $68.00, MiniMag Pro $68.00, COOLiFY Air $84.15. OUTLET32 (printed on torraslife.com, 'Special Deals 40% OFF') works only on selected variants: Q3 Air 17 Pro Max Forest Green -> $39.60 (best price for that record, so cart_variant is Forest Green). OUTLET33 (printed on the Football Limited page, 50%) works on the Football Limited case ($33.00) but on none of the picks. Q3AIRPRO10 and FOOTBALL10 (CJ) were rejected even on their own target products (1 unit, with the automatic 10% in the cart); possibly blocked by the non-stacking rule at a 10% tie, multi-unit not tested. Woitorras03250ZT (printed on torraslife.com product cards) was rejected everywhere. NO personal-cooling item on torraslife.com itself; the COOLiFY Air (Matte Black) was the only in-stock neck cooler on the COOLiFY store (2S, 2S Pro, Cyber Fold all sold out).

records.summary: TORRAS's most-reviewed iPhone 17 Pro Max case: a 3.35 mm MagSafe-compatible case with a ring stand that turns 360° and an 8 ft drop rating. On 2026-11-25 it cost $59.40 in TORRAS's US cart, or $39.60 in Forest Green with the store's code OUTLET32.
records.fit: Suits iPhone 17 Pro Max owners who want a built-in stand for video and calls plus MagSafe accessories in one case. Anyone who wants a slimmer case without a stand can pay less, for example the Smartish Gripmunk with MagSafe at $19.99 on smartish.com (2026-11-17).
caveats: The product page shows $65.99; the $59.40 price is the cart total after TORRAS's automatic 'Black Friday 10% all' discount (1 item 10%, 2 items 15%, 3+ items 20%, no code; TORRAS's Black Friday page runs 2026-11-19 to 12-02). Codes do not stack with it: a code replaces it only when larger.
OUTLET32 (printed on the product page as a 40% 'Special Deal') applied only to the Forest Green color in the cart test; Shadow Black rejected it.
TORRAS does not name the standard behind its 8 ft drop rating, and no independent drop test of this case was found.

A customer review on TORRAS's own product page says MagSafe charging does not pass through the case well and may need a stronger charger; TORRAS does not state a wireless-charging wattage through the case.
It fits only the iPhone 17 Pro Max; TORRAS sells separate Q3 Air models for the 17, 17 Pro and the iPhone 18 series.

records.summary: TORRAS's top iPhone 17 Pro Max case, with sealed dual airbags at the corners, an 18N magnetic ring for MagSafe accessories and a stand that rotates 360°. It cost $72.00 in TORRAS's US cart on 2026-11-25, or $68.00 with code WELCOMEBACK.
records.fit: Suits iPhone 17 Pro Max owners who drop their phone often and want corner airbags plus a built-in stand, and who don't mind extra bulk. For lighter protection with the same stand, TORRAS's Ostand Q3 Air costs $59.40 in the same cart.
caveats: The product page shows $79.99; the $72.00 price is the cart total after TORRAS's automatic 'Black Friday 10% all' discount (1 item 10%, 2 items 15%, 3+ items 20%, no code; TORRAS's Black Friday page runs 2026-11-19 to 12-02). Codes do not stack with it: a code replaces it only when larger.
The CJ code Q3AIRPRO10, which TORRAS offers for this case, was rejected in the cart for both colors tested while the automatic Black Friday 10% was active; WELCOMEBACK (15% off) applied instead.
Notebookcheck (Marcus Schwarten, 2026-09-20) calls the case 'quite large and heavy': about 53 g, adding about 1 cm in length to an iPhone 18 Pro.
Notebookcheck's drop check was several low-height corner drops, which the reviewer says does not prove protection from greater heights; TORRAS gives no drop height for this model.
TORRAS's product page does not state thickness, weight, materials or wireless-charging performance through the case (not stated by TORRAS).

records.summary: A 10,000 mAh magnetic power bank for iPhone with 15 W wireless and 30 W USB-C output and a semi-solid-state cell that TORRAS says resists puncture and runs cool. It cost $72.00 in TORRAS's US cart on 2026-11-25, or $68.00 with code WELCOMEBACK.
records.fit: Suits iPhone owners who want a slim magnetic battery that stays cool, and who care more about cell safety than charging speed. Anyone who wants faster 25 W Qi2.2 wireless charging for less can look at the Baseus PicoGo AM52 Qi2.2 10,000 mAh, $59.99 on Baseus's US store (2026-11-21).
caveats: The product page shows $79.99 struck from $99.99; the $72.00 price is the cart total after TORRAS's automatic 'Black Friday 10% all' discount (no code; Black Friday page runs 2026-11-19 to 12-02). Codes do not stack with it.
Wireless output is 15 W, below the 25 W of Qi2.2 power banks; Skeg Log's reviewer (Kazuto Takano, 2026-10-12) calls its charging slow and its price higher than same-capacity rivals.
Best Buy also lists a 'MiniMag Pro 10,000mAh Qi2.2 25W' version; the model on torraslife.com states 15 W, so the two listings should not be mixed up.
At 195 g and 14 mm it is thicker and heavier than the slimmest magnetic packs; Skeg Log's reviewer found it heavier than expected to carry.
TORRAS does not state the watt-hour rating or the USB-C input wattage; its FAQ says it meets civil-aviation carry-on standards without naming one.

records.warranty: TORRAS's warranty policy lists 1 year for personal fans (the COOLiFY store's own policy page gives a general 365 days), from when the original buyer receives it, for purchases from TORRAS or other authorized sellers; it covers quality defects, not misuse, liquid or other external damage.

records.summary: A 395 g bladeless neck cooler with a cooling plate at the back of the neck, fans that blow through 36 vents, and a heating mode for cold weather. It cost $99.00 (marked down from $149.00) on TORRAS's COOLiFY store on 2026-11-25, or $84.15 with code WELCOMEBACK.
records.fit: Suits people who overheat at work, outdoors or while commuting and want a cooling plate rather than a fan alone, and those who want a heated neck wrap in winter too. Anyone who only needs a breeze can spend less on TORRAS's COOLiFY IVA GO handheld fan at $49.00 on the same store.
caveats: It is sold on TORRAS's separate COOLiFY store (coolify.torraslife.com), which has its own cart and checkout and offered no automatic Black Friday discount on 2026-11-25; free shipping starts at $49.

The '10 degrees' cooling and 31 dB figures are TORRAS's claims; The Gadgeteer (Bill Henderson, 2025-05-18) found it louder up close on high fan and the runtime drops to about 4–6 hours with cooling and fans on max.
Battery capacity, charging time and in-box contents are not stated on TORRAS's product page; The Gadgeteer reports a 5,000 mAh battery and gives conflicting full-charge times (1–2 h and 3–4 h).
The product page FAQ describes a different model (the COOLiTE neck fan: 10.9 oz, 8,450 r/min), so its answers may not apply to the COOLiFY Air.
Only the Matte Black color was in stock on 2026-11-25.
